name: fairride-monorepo
description: FairRide - Intelligent Mobility Platform: Book With Confidence

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@fairride/types && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/constants && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/shared && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/validation
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/web && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/web && npm run build --workspace=@fairride/api
